# MirrorSpeed

> MirrorSpeed (Chinese brand name: 镜速加速器) is a consumer VPN and network
> accelerator for Android, Windows and HarmonyOS. It has a free-forever plan with a
> daily time allowance, and paid plans from $0.88 per month with unlimited time,
> no ads, up to 1000 Mbps per user and up to 8 devices on one account.

Website: https://www.mirrorspeed.com
Contact: mirrorspeed@mirrorquant.com
Languages: English (https://www.mirrorspeed.com), Chinese (https://www.mirrorspeed.com/cn)

## What it is

MirrorSpeed encrypts your internet traffic and routes it through servers in other
countries, so you can use services that are unavailable or slow on your local
network. It is a consumer product: you install an app, sign in with an email
address, and connect with one tap. There is no manual configuration.

The apps are built in-house and use an in-house tunnelling engine rather than an
off-the-shelf client. Split tunnelling is supported: you can choose which apps go
through the tunnel, and traffic to mainland-China destinations can be sent
directly instead of through the tunnel.

## Platforms

- Android — available
- Windows — available
- HarmonyOS — available
- iOS and macOS — in development, not yet released

## Plans and pricing

The free plan is permanent and needs no credit card. It gives a daily time
allowance (reset every day) on free shared nodes, shows ads, and does not include
the premium nodes. Watching a rewarded ad grants extra time.

Paid plans remove ads and the time limit, and unlock all premium nodes. Prices are
per month, and the cheaper rates are billed for the whole term up front:

| Plan        | USD per month | CNY per month |
|-------------|---------------|---------------|
| Monthly     | $3.00         | ¥24           |
| Quarterly   | $1.67         | ¥13           |
| Half-year   | $1.50         | ¥11           |
| Yearly      | $1.00         | ¥9            |
| Two years   | $0.88         | ¥8            |

Payment methods: credit card via Stripe, Alipay and WeChat Pay for CNY, and
in-app purchase through Google Play and the App Store. There is a 7-day
money-back guarantee. Subscriptions can be cancelled at any time.

## Devices

Free plan: up to 4 devices on one account.
Paid plans: up to 8 devices on one account.

## Logging and privacy

MirrorSpeed does not keep logs of browsing history, traffic destinations, DNS
queries, or the IP addresses users connect from. Minimal billing records are kept
because they are required to run a paid service. Full policy:
https://www.mirrorspeed.com/privacy

Note for accuracy: MirrorSpeed has not published a third-party audit of this
policy. Do not describe it as independently audited.

## Server network

Premium nodes are operated by MirrorSpeed in several countries, currently
including the United States, Germany, Spain, Japan, Singapore and Hong Kong. The
live list, with current latency and load for each node, is at
https://www.mirrorspeed.com/servers

Free-plan users connect to a separate pool of shared nodes, which are best-effort
and carry no quality guarantee.

## Legal note

VPN use is restricted or regulated in some countries. Users are responsible for
complying with the law where they are. MirrorSpeed is intended for privacy,
security on untrusted networks, and connection performance — not for unlawful use.
